title: Bigin restricted picklist rejects values sent through the API
symptoms: Picklist field stays empty after an API create
A deleted field's name cannot be reused
cause: Restricted picklists refuse values from integrations even when the value is in the list. A field's type cannot be changed, and deleted fields move to Unused Fields with their names still reserved.
fix: Create a new single line text field under a new name and point the integration at it. Refresh the module's field list in any integration tool that caches it.
apply: Bigin Setup > Fields > Pipelines: add a Single Line field with a new name, then map the integration to it
